name: qa-portfolio-api-newman
description: Project 03 - Postman/Newman regression for the DummyJSON public test API

scripts.test: npm run test:regression && npm run test:data-driven
scripts.test:regression: newman run postman/DemoShop-API.postman_collection.json -e postman/dummyjson.postman_environment.json --folder Auth --folder Products --folder Carts --folder Users --folder "Negative & validation" --delay-request 50 -r cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export target/newman/regression-junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export target/newman/regression-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "DemoShop API regression"
scripts.test:data-driven: newman run postman/DemoShop-API.postman_collection.json -e postman/dummyjson.postman_environment.json --folder "Data-driven products" -d postman/data/products.csv -r cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export target/newman/data-driven-junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export target/newman/data-driven-report.html
